correctness.rationale: Before positives, each negative response splits one candidate interval block into two unqueried blocks. After a positive, allowable left/right endpoints are independent contiguous threshold parameters, whose Littlestone dimensions add as floorlog2 left-options plus floorlog2 right-options. Standard binary-tree min-max recurrence yields D(S) on block-length multiset, decreasing total block length each step; excluded empty negative branches are constant. Independently recomputed all n<=55 through exact multiset recurrence, 526822 cached states, and obtained threshold list; direct unrestricted concept-mask online shattering for n<=11 matched; independently read and validated the depth-10 n=55 tree: 1023 nodes and 1024 unique legal interval leaf witnesses. Finite cutoff is expressly bounded n<=55.
